headline: [Most Wanted Caught!] Mexico Captures 'El Chapo Isidro', [11 Dead] in Firefight
sub: He was on the FBI's 10 Most Wanted list
caption:
🚔 Most Wanted Caught! Mexico Captures 'El Chapo Isidro', 11 Dead in Firefight

Mexican forces captured alleged cartel leader Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as "El Chapo Isidro", in the city of Guasave in Sinaloa state. The raid began on Friday night and led to a deadly firefight.

🔹 Mexico's Defense Ministry said at least 11 people were killed: seven alleged cartel gunmen and four Mexican soldiers.
🔹 He was one of the FBI's 10 Most Wanted fugitives, with a reward of up to $5 million. He is wanted in the U.S. on drug trafficking and firearms charges.
🔹 Burning vehicles blocked roads in Guasave after the arrest. Mexico's Security Secretary Omar García Harfuch said armed forces will stay deployed in Sinaloa.

Sources: AP, CBS News
